addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". 314	def _iso_to_ts(iso_str: str | None) -> int | None:
315	    """将 ISO 时间字符串转为毫秒 Unix 时间戳（飞书 DATE 字段格式）。"""
316	    if not iso_str:
317	        return None
318	    from datetime import datetime, timezone
319	
320	    # 尝试 YYYY-MM-DD 或 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
321	    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", "%Y-%m-%d"):
322	        try:
323	            dt = datetime.strptime(iso_str, fmt)
324	            return int(dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1000)
325	        except ValueError:
326	            continue
327	    return None

  1 文本
  2 数字
  3 单选
  4 多选
  5 日期
  7 复选框
  11 人员

  15 超链接
  17 电话

  19 查找引用（不支持 API 创建/更新，需在飞书 UI 手动配置）

    if extra:
        d["property"] = extra.get("property") if "property" in extra else extra
        if d["property"] is None:
            d.pop("property", None)
    return d


def _single(name: str, options: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:

def make_asin_pk(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return "|".join(
        [

            str(row.get("marketplace") or ""),
            str(row.get("shop_name") or ""),
            str(row.get("asin") or ""),
        ]
    )


def row_to_asin_fields(row: dict[str, Any], *, sync_run_id: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    fields: dict[str, Any] = {"主键": make_asin_pk(row)}
    for k, title in ASIN_FIELD_MAP.items():
        if k in row and row[k] is not None:
            fields[title] = row[k]
    # 日期字段使用时间戳（兼容飞书 DATE 类型）
    if row.get("biz_date"):
        fields["日期"] = _biz_date_ts(str(row["biz_date"]))
    if sync_run_id is not None:
        fields["同步批次"] = sync_run_id
    return fields


def _iso_to_ts(iso_str: str | None) -> int | None:
    """将 ISO 时间字符串转为毫秒 Unix 时间戳（飞书 DATE 字段格式）。"""
    if not iso_str:
        return None
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    # 尝试 YYYY-MM-DD 或 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", "%Y-%m-%d"):
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime(iso_str, fmt)
            return int(dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1000)
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def _task_metric_fields(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """从任务列或 payload_json 取指标语义字段。"""
    payload = task.get("payload_json")
    if isinstance(payload, str) and payload:
        import json

        try:
            payload = json.loads(payload)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            payload = {}
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        payload = {}

    def pick(key: str) -> Any:
        v = task.get(key)
        if v is not None and v != "":
            return v
        return payload.get(key)

    message = pick("message")
    summary = pick("value_summary")
    # 说明优先：判定文案 + 指标摘要（便于负责人一眼看懂）
    note_parts = [p for p in (message, summary) if p]
    note = " | ".join(note_parts) if note_parts else None
    return {
        "当前值含义": pick("current_label"),
        "对比值含义": pick("baseline_label"),
        "变化幅度含义": pick("change_label"),
        "指标摘要": summary,
        "说明": note,
    }

        "日期": _biz_date_ts(str(task.get("biz_date") or ""))
        if task.get("biz_date")
        else None,
        "店铺": task.get("shop_name"),
        "ASIN": task.get("asin"),
        "产品": task.get("product_title"),
        "中文名称": task.get("product_title_cn"),
        "异常类型": task.get("anomaly_type"),
        "等级": task.get("level"),
        "当前值": task.get("current_value"),
        "对比值": task.get("baseline_value"),
        "变化幅度": task.get("change_value"),
        "负责人": task.get("owner"),
        "审核人": task.get("reviewer"),
        "状态": task.get("status") or "open",
        "截止时间": _iso_to_ts(task.get("due_at")),
        "连续异常次数": task.get("streak"),
        "需要老板决策": bool(task.get("need_boss")),
    }
    fields.update(_task_metric_fields(task))
    return fields


def action_pk_for_task(task_id: str) -> str:
    return f"A-{task_id}"


def action_shell_from_task(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """系统预建动作空壳：只填定位/责任信息，原因与采取动作留给负责人补全。

    写入策略必须为 create-only（已存在则不覆盖），避免冲掉人工填写。
    """
    task_id = str(task.get("task_id") or "")
    title_cn = task.get("product_title_cn") or ""
    title = task.get("product_title") or ""
    name = title_cn or title
    hint_parts = [
        "【系统预建】请负责人核实后补全：是否属实 / 原因 / 采取动作 / 复查日期",
        f"等级={task.get('level')}",
        f"类型={task.get('anomaly_type')}",
    ]
    if name:
        hint_parts.append(f"品名={name}")
    return {
        "主键": action_pk_for_task(task_id),
        "关联异常编号": task_id,
        "店铺": task.get("shop_name"),
        "ASIN": task.get("asin"),
        "中文名称": title_cn or None,
        "异常类型": task.get("anomaly_type"),
        "等级": task.get("level"),
        "是否属实": "待核实",

        "执行日期": _biz_date_ts(str(task.get("biz_date") or ""))
        if task.get("biz_date")
        else None,
        "执行人": task.get("owner"),
        "闭环状态": "待核实",

    """将 'YYYY-MM-DD' 转为毫秒 Unix 时间戳（飞书日期字段格式）。"""
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    dt = datetime.strptime(biz_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
    return int(dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp() * 1000)

431	def _backfill_pair(
432	    settings: Settings,
433	    task_table_id: str,
434	    action_table_id: str,
435	    *,
436	    label: str = "mother",
437	) -> dict[str, int]:
438	    """单对 任务表↔动作表 回填关联与动作文本列。"""
439	    from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient
440	
441	    app_token = settings.feishu_bitable_app_token
442	    LINK_FIELD = "关联运营动作"
443	    linked = 0
444	    synced = 0
445	
446	    with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
447	        task_fields = client.list_fields(app_token, task_table_id)
448	        task_field_names = {f.get("field_name") for f in task_fields}
449	
450	        action_info: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
451	        for item in client.iter_records(app_token, action_table_id, page_size=100):
452	            rid = item.get("record_id")
453	            fields = item.get("fields") or {}
454	            key = str(fields.get("关联异常编号") or "").strip()
455	            if key and rid:
456	                action_info[key] = {"record_id": rid, "fields": fields}
457	
458	        to_link: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
459	        to_sync_action: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
460	
461	        for item in client.iter_records(app_token, task_table_id, page_size=100):
462	            rid = item.get("record_id")
463	            fields = item.get("fields") or {}
464	            task_no = str(fields.get("异常编号") or "").strip()
465	            if not task_no or not rid:
466	                continue
467	            action = action_info.get(task_no)
468	            if not action:
469	                continue
470	
471	            if LINK_FIELD in task_field_names:
472	                link_val = fields.get(LINK_FIELD)
473	                has_real_link = False
474	                if link_val and isinstance(link_val, list):
475	                    for lv in link_val:
476	                        if isinstance(lv, dict) and lv.get("record_ids"):
477	                            has_real_link = True
478	                            break
479	                if not has_real_link:
480	                    to_link.append(
481	                        {
482	                            "record_id": rid,
483	                            "fields": {LINK_FIELD: [action["record_id"]]},
484	                        }
485	                    )
486	
487	            action_updates = {}
488	            for task_col, action_col in ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS.items():
489	                if task_col not in task_field_names:
490	                    continue
491	                action_val = action["fields"].get(action_col)
492	                if action_val is not None and str(action_val).strip():
493	                    existing = fields.get(task_col)
494	                    if not existing or str(existing).strip() != str(action_val).strip():
495	                        action_updates[task_col] = action_val
496	            if action_updates:
497	                to_sync_action.append({"record_id": rid, "fields": action_updates})
498	
499	        for i in range(0, len(to_link), 100):
500	            chunk = to_link[i : i + 100]
501	            try:
502	                client.bitable_batch_update(app_token, task_table_id, chunk)
503	                linked += len(chunk)
504	            except Exception:
505	                logger.exception("关联回填批次失败 label=%s i=%s", label, i)
506	            time.sleep(0.2)
507	
508	        for i in range(0, len(to_sync_action), 100):
509	            chunk = to_sync_action[i : i + 100]
510	            try:
511	                client.bitable_batch_update(app_token, task_table_id, chunk)
512	                synced += len(chunk)
513	            except Exception:
514	                logger.exception("动作数据同步批次失败 label=%s i=%s", label, i)
515	            time.sleep(0.2)
516	
517	    logger.info("关联回填[%s]: linked=%d action_synced=%d", label, linked, synced)
518	    return {"linked": linked, "action_synced": synced}

from __future__ import annotations

import json as _json
import logging
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any

from app.config import Settings, get_app_config, get_settings
from app.store.db import Database

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def build_digest(db: Database, biz_date: str) -> str:
    """构建纯文本摘要（保留为 fallback）。"""
    tasks = db.list_tasks(biz_date=biz_date)
    open_tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")]
    by_owner: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for t in open_tasks:
        by_owner[str(t.get("owner") or "未分配")].append(t)

    red = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "red")
    orange = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "orange")
    lines = [
        f"【ASIN健康度】{biz_date} 异常摘要",
        f"红色: {red} | 橙色: {orange} | 未关闭合计: {len(open_tasks)}",
        "",
    ]
    cfg = get_app_config()
    view_url = (cfg.get("notify") or {}).get("view_base_url") or ""
    if view_url:
        lines.append(f"视图: {view_url}")
        lines.append("")

    for owner, items in sorted(by_owner.items()):
        r = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "red")
        o = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "orange")
        lines.append(f"- {owner}: 红{r} 橙{o}")
        for t in items[:5]:
            lines.append(
                f"  · [{t.get('level')}] {t.get('shop_name')} {t.get('asin')} {t.get('anomaly_type')}"
            )
        if len(items) > 5:
            lines.append(f"  · …另有 {len(items) - 5} 条")

    if not open_tasks:
        lines.append("今日无新增未关闭橙/红任务。")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def build_digest_card(
    db: Database, biz_date: str, *, settings: Settings | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """构建每日摘要交互式卡片。"""
    from app.clients.feishu import (
        card_action,
        card_button,
        card_header,
        card_hr,
        card_md,
    )

    settings = settings or get_settings()
    cfg = get_app_config()
    notify = cfg.get("notify") or {}
    base_url = (notify.get("view_base_url") or "").rstrip("?&")
    if not base_url and settings.feishu_bitable_app_token:
        base_url = f"https://dcnkj1up67d5.feishu.cn/base/{settings.feishu_bitable_app_token}"

    tasks_url = base_url
    actions_url = base_url
    if settings.feishu_table_tasks:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base_url else "?"
        tasks_url = f"{base_url}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_tasks}"
    if settings.feishu_table_actions:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base_url else "?"
        actions_url = f"{base_url}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_actions}"

    tasks = db.list_tasks(biz_date=biz_date)
    open_tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")]
    yellow_tasks = [t for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "yellow"]
    by_owner: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for t in open_tasks:
        by_owner[str(t.get("owner") or "未分配")].append(t)

    red = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "red")
    orange = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "orange")
    yellow = len(yellow_tasks)

    # 卡片颜色：有红色→红，有橙色→橙，否则蓝
    card_color = "blue"
    if red:
        card_color = "red"
    elif orange:
        card_color = "orange"

    # 逾期统计
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    overdue_n = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if (due := t.get("due_at")) and due < now)

    # KPI 行
    kpi_parts = [
        f"🔴 **红色**: {red}",
        f"🟠 **橙色**: {orange}",
        f"🟡 **观察**: {yellow}",
    ]
    if overdue_n:
        kpi_parts.append(f"⏰ **逾期**: {overdue_n}")

    md_lines = [f"📊 **{biz_date}** 异常摘要", "", " | ".join(kpi_parts), ""]

    if not open_tasks:
        md_lines.append("✅ 今日无新增未关闭橙/红任务。")
    else:
        md_lines.append("---")
        md_lines.append("")
        for owner, items in sorted(by_owner.items()):
            r = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "red")
            o = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "orange")
            md_lines.append(f"👤 **{owner}**: 🔴{r} 🟠{o}")
            for t in items[:5]:
                icon = "🔴" if t.get("level") == "red" else "🟠"
                cn = t.get("product_title_cn") or t.get("product_title") or ""
                cn_s = f" {cn}" if cn else ""
                md_lines.append(
                    f"  {icon} `{t.get('task_id')}` {t.get('shop_name')} "
                    f"{t.get('asin')}{cn_s} | {t.get('anomaly_type')}"
                )
            if len(items) > 5:
                md_lines.append(f"  …另有 {len(items) - 5} 条")
            md_lines.append("")

    elements = [
        card_md("\n".join(md_lines)),
        card_hr(),
        card_action(
            card_button("📋 查看任务表", tasks_url),
            card_button("📝 查看动作表", actions_url),
        ),
    ]

    return {
        **card_header(
            f"ASIN健康度 · {biz_date} 异常摘要", color=card_color
        ),
        "elements": elements,
    }


def _send_msg(
    text: str | None,
    card: dict[str, Any] | None,
    webhook: str,
    *,
    use_card: bool = True,
) -> bool:
    """发送消息：优先卡片，fallback 文本。返回是否发送成功。"""
    if use_card and card:
        try:
            from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient

            if get_settings().has_feishu:
                with FeishuClient() as client:
                    client.send_webhook_card(card, webhook=webhook)
            else:
                import httpx
                resp = httpx.post(webhook, json={"msg_type": "interactive", "card": card}, timeout=30)
                resp.raise_for_status()
            return True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("卡片发送失败，回退文本")

    if text:
        try:
            import httpx
            resp = httpx.post(
                webhook,
                json={"msg_type": "text", "content": {"text": text}},
                timeout=30,
            )
            resp.raise_for_status()
            data = resp.json() if resp.content else {}
            if data.get("code") not in (None, 0) and data.get("StatusCode") not in (None, 0):
                logger.error("飞书 webhook 返回异常: %s", data)
            return True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("文本消息发送也失败")
    return False


def send_digest(
    db: Database,
    biz_date: str,
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> str:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    text = build_digest(db, biz_date)
    card = build_digest_card(db, biz_date, settings=settings)

    payload = {"biz_date": biz_date, "text": text, "card": card}
    db.log_notify("daily_digest", payload)

    if dry_run:
        logger.info("Digest dry-run:\n%s\nCard:\n%s", text, _json.dumps(card, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return text

    webhook = (settings.feishu_bot_webhook or "").strip()
    if not webhook:
        logger.warning(
            "未配置 FEISHU_BOT_WEBHOOK，摘要仅写入 notify_log。"
            "请在飞书群添加自定义机器人，把 Webhook 写入 .env"
        )
        return text

    _send_msg(text, card, webhook)
    logger.info("飞书摘要已发送")
    return text

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""在异常任务表末尾追加运营动作信息列，并建立与运营动作记录表的关联。

实现步骤：
  1. 在「异常任务」表创建单向关联字段（type=18）→ 「运营动作记录」表
  2. 创建文本列：「动作-闭环状态」「动作-原因」「动作-采取动作」「动作-是否有效」「动作-复查日期」
  3. 回填已有记录的关联关系和数据（按"关联异常编号"="异常编号"匹配）
  4. 日报运行时自动维护这些列的数据

用法:
  python scripts/setup_action_lookup.py            # 完整执行
  python scripts/setup_action_lookup.py --dry-run  # 仅检测，不创建/写入
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient
from app.config import get_settings

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("setup_action_lookup")

# ── 配置 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LINK_FIELD_NAME = "关联运营动作"      # 单向关联字段（type=18）

# 从运营动作记录表复制到异常任务表的字段: { 任务表列名: 动作表列名 }
ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS: dict[str, str] = {
    "动作-闭环状态": "闭环状态",
    "动作-原因": "原因",
    "动作-采取动作": "采取动作",
    "动作-是否有效": "是否有效",
    "动作-复查日期": "复查日期",
}


def setup(
    client: FeishuClient,
    app_token: str,
    task_table_id: str,
    action_table_id: str,
    *,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "link_field_created": False,
        "text_columns_created": [],
        "links_backfilled": 0,
        "action_data_backfilled": 0,
    }

    # ── 1. 获取现有字段 ──────────────────────────────────────────
    logger.info("=== 获取异常任务表字段 ===")
    task_fields = client.list_fields(app_token, task_table_id)
    task_field_names = {f.get("field_name") for f in task_fields}

    logger.info("=== 获取运营动作记录表字段 ===")
    action_fields = client.list_fields(app_token, action_table_id)
    action_field_names = {f.get("field_name") for f in action_fields}

    if "异常编号" not in task_field_names:
        logger.error("异常任务表缺少「异常编号」字段！")
        return result
    if "关联异常编号" not in action_field_names:
        logger.error("运营动作记录表缺少「关联异常编号」字段！")
        return result

    # ── 2. 创建单向关联字段（type=18） ──────────────────────────
    if LINK_FIELD_NAME in task_field_names:
        for f in task_fields:
            if f["field_name"] == LINK_FIELD_NAME:
                logger.info("关联字段 [%s] 已存在 (id=%s type=%s)", LINK_FIELD_NAME, f.get("field_id"), f.get("type"))
                break
        result["link_field_created"] = False
    else:
        if dry_run:
            logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将创建单向关联字段 [%s]", LINK_FIELD_NAME)
            result["link_field_created"] = True
        else:
            resp = client.create_field(
                app_token, task_table_id, LINK_FIELD_NAME, 18,
                property_={"table_id": action_table_id},
            )
            fid = resp.get("field", {}).get("field_id") or resp.get("field_id")
            logger.info("✅ 创建单向关联字段 [%s] (id=%s)", LINK_FIELD_NAME, fid)
            result["link_field_created"] = True
            task_field_names.add(LINK_FIELD_NAME)
            time.sleep(0.3)

    # ── 3. 创建动作信息文本列 ───────────────────────────────────
    for col_name in ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS:
        if col_name in task_field_names:
            logger.info("字段 [%s] 已存在，跳过", col_name)
        else:
            if dry_run:
                logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将创建文本字段 [%s]", col_name)
                result["text_columns_created"].append(col_name)
            else:
                client.create_field(app_token, task_table_id, col_name, 1)
                logger.info("✅ 创建文本字段 [%s]", col_name)
                result["text_columns_created"].append(col_name)
                task_field_names.add(col_name)
                time.sleep(0.15)

    # ── 4. 回填关联关系 ─────────────────────────────────────────
    logger.info("=== 回填关联关系 ===")

    # 读取运营动作表
    action_info: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for item in client.iter_records(app_token, action_table_id, page_size=100):
        rid = item.get("record_id")
        fields = item.get("fields") or {}
        key = str(fields.get("关联异常编号") or "").strip()
        if key:
            action_info[key] = {"record_id": rid, "fields": fields}
    logger.info("运营动作记录: %d 条", len(action_info))

    # 读取异常任务表，找出需要回填的记录
    to_link: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    to_update_action: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for item in client.iter_records(app_token, task_table_id, page_size=100):
        rid = item.get("record_id")
        fields = item.get("fields") or {}
        task_no = str(fields.get("异常编号") or "").strip()
        if not task_no or not rid:
            continue
        action = action_info.get(task_no)
        if not action:
            continue

        # 检查是否需要回填关联
        link_val = fields.get(LINK_FIELD_NAME)
        has_real_link = False
        if link_val and isinstance(link_val, list):
            for lv in link_val:
                if isinstance(lv, dict) and lv.get("record_ids"):
                    has_real_link = True
                    break
        if not has_real_link:
            to_link.append({
                "record_id": rid,
                "fields": {LINK_FIELD_NAME: [action["record_id"]]},
            })

        # 检查是否需要回填动作文本列
        action_updates = {}
        for task_col, action_col in ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS.items():
            action_val = action["fields"].get(action_col)
            if action_val is not None and str(action_val).strip():
                existing = fields.get(task_col)
                if not existing or str(existing).strip() != str(action_val).strip():
                    action_updates[task_col] = action_val
        if action_updates:
            to_update_action.append({"record_id": rid, "fields": action_updates})

    result["links_backfilled"] = len(to_link)
    result["action_data_backfilled"] = len(to_update_action)

    if to_link:
        if dry_run:
            logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将回填 %d 条关联", len(to_link))
        else:
            for i in range(0, len(to_link), 100):
                chunk = to_link[i : i + 100]
                client.bitable_batch_update(app_token, task_table_id, chunk)
                logger.info("  关联回填 %d/%d", min(i + 100, len(to_link)), len(to_link))
                time.sleep(0.2)
            logger.info("✅ 关联回填完成: %d 条", len(to_link))
    else:
        logger.info("无需回填（所有关联已就绪）")

    if to_update_action:
        if dry_run:
            logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将更新 %d 条动作数据", len(to_update_action))
        else:
            for i in range(0, len(to_update_action), 100):
                chunk = to_update_action[i : i + 100]
                client.bitable_batch_update(app_token, task_table_id, chunk)
                logger.info("  动作数据 %d/%d", min(i + 100, len(to_update_action)), len(to_update_action))
                time.sleep(0.2)
            logger.info("✅ 动作数据回填完成: %d 条", len(to_update_action))
    else:
        logger.info("无需回填动作数据")

    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="异常任务表添加运营动作信息列")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="只检测不写入")

1	"""店铺名称规范化与按店飞书子表注册表。
2	
3	规范名（canonical）用于：
4	  - 子表命名：ASIN每日数据__Ledvia-UK
5	  - 写入路由：raw shop_name → canonicalize → 子表 table_id
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import json
11	import logging
12	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
13	from pathlib import Path
14	from typing import Any, Iterable

16	from app.config import ROOT_DIR, get_app_config, get_settings

18	logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

20	# 默认别名 → 规范店名
21	DEFAULT_SHOP_ALIASES: dict[str, str] = {
22	    "LEDVIE": "Ledvia-UK",

24	    "Ledvia-UK": "Ledvia-UK",

36	    "起的快": "起的快-UK",

38	    "字同": "字同道合",

43	KIND_TO_MOTHER_NAME: dict[str, str] = {
44	    "asin_daily": "ASIN每日数据",
45	    "tasks": "异常任务",
46	    "actions": "运营动作记录",

55	def load_alias_map() -> dict[str, str]:
56	    m = dict(DEFAULT_SHOP_ALIASES)
57	    cfg = get_app_config()
58	    extra = cfg.get("shop_aliases") or {}
59	    if isinstance(extra, dict):
60	        for k, v in extra.items():
61	            if k and v:
62	                m[str(k).strip()] = str(v).strip()
63	    return m

66	def canonicalize_shop(name: str | None, aliases: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> str:
67	    """原始店名 → 规范名；空串返回空串。"""
68	    if not name:
69	        return ""
70	    name = str(name).strip()
71	    if not name:
72	        return ""
73	    aliases = aliases if aliases is not None else load_alias_map()
74	    if name in aliases:
75	        return aliases[name]
76	    lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in aliases.items()}
77	    return lower.get(name.lower(), name)

79	
80	def shop_match_variants(
81	    canonical: str, aliases: dict[str, str] | None = None
82	) -> list[str]:
83	    """规范名对应的全部写法（含自身），规范名在前。"""
84	    aliases = aliases if aliases is not None else load_alias_map()
85	    names = {canonical}
86	    for alias, can in aliases.items():
87	        if can == canonical:
88	            names.add(alias)
89	    rest = sorted(n for n in names if n != canonical)
90	    return [canonical] + rest

93	def list_canonical_shops_from_names(names: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:
94	    aliases = load_alias_map()
95	    seen: set[str] = set()
96	    out: list[str] = []
97	    for n in names:
98	        can = canonicalize_shop(n, aliases)
99	        if can and can not in seen:
100	            seen.add(can)
101	            out.append(can)
102	    return sorted(out)

106	    from app.store.db import Database
107

111	        return list_canonical_shops_from_names(load_alias_map().values())
112	    db = Database(path)

114	        rows = conn.execute(

116	            "WHERE shop_name IS NOT NULL AND shop_name != ''"
117	        ).fetchall()
118	    raw = [str(r["shop_name"]) for r in rows]
119	    cans = list_canonical_shops_from_names(raw)
120	    if not cans:
121	        cans = list_canonical_shops_from_names(load_alias_map().values())
122	    return cans

125	def child_table_name(mother_name: str, canonical_shop: str) -> str:
126	    """子表命名：ASIN每日数据__Ledvia-UK"""

130	def parse_child_table_name(name: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
131	    """解析 母表名__店名 → (mother, shop)；非分表名返回 None。"""
132	    if "__" not in name:
133	        return None
134	    mother, shop = name.rsplit("__", 1)
135	    if not mother or not shop:
136	        return None
137	    return mother, shop

140	@dataclass
141	class ShopTableRegistry:
142	    """shop → {kind: table_id}"""
143	
144	    data: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = field(default_factory=dict)
145	    path: Path | None = None
146	
147	    def get(self, canonical_shop: str, kind: str) -> str | None:
148	        shop = self.data.get(canonical_shop) or {}
149	        tid = shop.get(kind)
150	        return tid if tid else None
151	
152	    def set(self, canonical_shop: str, kind: str, table_id: str) -> None:
153	        self.data.setdefault(canonical_shop, {})[kind] = table_id
154	
155	    def shops(self) -> list[str]:
156	        return sorted(self.data.keys())
157	
158	    def all_table_ids(self, kind: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
159	        """[(shop, table_id), ...]"""
160	        out = []
161	        for shop, kinds in sorted(self.data.items()):
162	            tid = kinds.get(kind)
163	            if tid:
164	                out.append((shop, tid))
165	        return out
166	
167	    def save(self, path: Path | None = None) -> Path:
168	        p = Path(path or self.path or default_registry_path())
169	        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
170	        with p.open("w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
171	            json.dump(self.data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
172	        self.path = p
173	        return p
174	
175	    @classmethod
176	    def load(cls, path: Path | None = None) -> ShopTableRegistry:
177	        p = Path(path or default_registry_path())
178	        if not p.exists():
179	            return cls(data={}, path=p)
180	        try:
181	            with p.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
182	                raw = json.load(f) or {}
183	            if not isinstance(raw, dict):
184	                return cls(data={}, path=p)
185	            data: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
186	            for shop, kinds in raw.items():
187	                if isinstance(kinds, dict):
188	                    data[str(shop)] = {
189	                        str(k): str(v) for k, v in kinds.items() if k and v
190	                    }
191	            return cls(data=data, path=p)
192	        except Exception:
193	            logger.exception("加载 shop table registry 失败: %s", p)
194	            return cls(data={}, path=p)
195	
196	
197	def default_registry_path() -> Path:
198	    settings = get_settings()
199	    # 允许 env / 配置覆盖
200	    cfg = get_app_config()
201	    sync = cfg.get("sync") or {}
202	    custom = sync.get("shop_tables_path") or ""
203	    if custom:
204	        p = Path(custom)
205	        if not p.is_absolute():
206	            p = ROOT_DIR / p
207	        return p
208	    return Path(settings.data_dir) / "feishu_shop_tables.json"
209	
210	
211	def dual_write_enabled() -> bool:
212	    cfg = get_app_config()
213	    sync = cfg.get("sync") or {}
214	    return bool(sync.get("dual_write_shop_tables", True))
215	
216	
217	def group_rows_by_canonical_shop(
218	    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
219	    *,
220	    shop_key: str = "shop_name",
221	) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
222	    """按规范店名分组；无法解析的进 key ''。"""
223	    aliases = load_alias_map()

225	    for r in rows:

227	        can = canonicalize_shop(str(raw) if raw else "", aliases)
228	        groups.setdefault(can, []).append(r)
229	    return groups

# Plan: 合并运营动作记录表到异常任务表

## Context

当前飞书多维表格中，"异常任务"和"运营动作记录"是两个独立的表，通过单向关联(type=18)和 `backfill_task_action_links()` 每日回填机制同步数据（动作-闭环状态、动作-原因等 5 个文本列）。这增加了：
- 表间关联维护的复杂度
- 双重写入（`write_action_shells_to_feishu` + `backfill_task_action_links`）
- 用户需要在两个表之间切换

**目标**：将运营动作记录的所有字段直接合并到异常任务表中，取消独立的运营动作记录表，简化数据模型和日常同步流程。

## 改动文件清单

### 1. `app/sync/feishu_schema.py` — 核心 schema 变更

**TASK_FIELDS 变更**：
- 删除：`关联运营动作`(type=18)、`动作-闭环状态`、`动作-原因`、`动作-采取动作`、`动作-是否有效`、`动作-复查日期`
- 新增（来自原 ACTION_FIELDS 的独有字段）：`是否属实`、`原因`、`判断依据`、`采取动作`、`执行日期`、`执行人`、`需审核事项`、`复查日期`、`动作前数据`、`动作后数据`、`是否有效`、`下一步动作`、`闭环状态`

**删除**：
- `ACTION_FIELDS` 整个列表
- `action_pk_for_task()` 函数
- `action_shell_from_task()` 函数

**TABLE_SPECS**：删除 `{"env_key": "FEISHU_TABLE_ACTIONS", "name": "运营动作记录", ...}`

**task_to_fields()**：增加 action 相关字段的映射（从 task dict 中读取，初始为空/None）

### 2. `app/config.py`
- 删除 `feishu_table_actions` Field 定义

### 3. `app/sync/writer.py` — 删除整个动作表写入/回填体系
- 删除 `ACTION_SYSTEM_FIELD_NAMES`
- 删除 `ensure_action_table_columns()`
- 删除 `write_action_shells_to_feishu()`
- 删除 `ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS`
- 删除 `_backfill_pair()`
- 删除 `backfill_task_action_links()`
- `write_tasks_to_feishu()`: 删除 `fields.pop("关联运营动作", None)` 这一行

### 4. `app/notify/actions.py` — 简化 dispatch 流程
- 删除 `write_action_shells_to_feishu` 和 `backfill_task_action_links` 的 import
- 删除 `dispatch_open_tasks()` 中的 `create_action_shells` 参数及相关逻辑（步骤 54-64）
- `dispatch_open_tasks()` 返回值去掉 `action_shells` 和 `task_action_links`

### 5. `app/notify/owner_push.py` — 只保留任务表链接
- `_view_urls()`: 删除 `actions_url`，只返回 `tasks_url`
- `_build_owner_card()`: 去掉 `actions_url` 参数，按钮改为只有"查看任务表"
- `build_owner_messages()`: 更新文案（从"打开运营动作记录"改为"在任务表中补全"），去掉 actions_url
- 卡片按钮只保留一个"查看任务表"

### 6. `app/notify/daily_digest.py` — 只保留任务表链接
- `build_digest_card()`: 删除 `actions_url`，按钮只保留"查看任务表"

### 7. `app/main.py` — CLI 命令更新
- 删除 `push-action-shells` 命令（或将其改为 no-op 提示）
- `dispatch_cmd`: 删除 `--no-actions` 参数及相关逻辑
- `backfill_shop_tables_cmd`: 删除 action_shells 和 links 回填逻辑

### 8. `app/sync/shops.py` — 删除 actions kind
- `KIND_TO_MOTHER_NAME`: 删除 `"actions": "运营动作记录"`
- `TABLE_KINDS`: 自动更新（从 KIND_TO_MOTHER_NAME 推导）

### 9. `scripts/init_shop_tables.py` — 不再创建 action 子表
- `ENV_TO_KIND`: 删除 `"FEISHU_TABLE_ACTIONS": "actions"`
- 删除创建 action 子表的逻辑
- 删除创建单向关联字段的逻辑
- 删除 action 定位列补充的逻辑

### 10. `scripts/setup_action_lookup.py` — 整个文件废弃
- 此脚本的唯一作用是在任务表上创建关联列和动作文本列，合并后毫无意义
- 可直接删除或在文件顶部标注"已废弃"

### 11. `scripts/migrate_feishu_fields.py`
- `name_to_id`: 删除 `"运营动作记录": settings.feishu_table_actions`

### 12. `.env.example`
- 删除 `FEISHU_TABLE_ACTIONS=` 行

### 13. `docs/飞书接入指南.md`
- 删除 `FEISHU_TABLE_ACTIONS` 相关行

## 关键设计决策

1. **字段命名**：直接使用原始 ACTION 字段名（如 `原因`、`采取动作`、`闭环状态`），不再加"动作-"前缀。这些字段在任务表中语义清晰。

2. **初始值**：合并后，新 action 字段在任务记录中初始为空。负责人直接在任务表上编辑这些字段（取代之前在动作表编辑再由回填同步的模式）。

3. **向后兼容**：`feishu_table_actions` 配置项保留在 `.env` 中不会导致错误（pydantic `extra="ignore"`），但脚本不再使用它。

## 验证

1. 运行 `python -c "from app.sync.feishu_schema import TASK_FIELDS, TABLE_SPECS; print('OK')"` 确认 schema 可导入
2. 运行 `python -c "from app.config import get_settings; print(get_settings().feishu_table_tasks)"` 确认配置正常
3. 运行现有测试：`python -m pytest tests/ -v`（如果涉及相关模块）
4. 检查 `scripts/init_shop_tables.py --dry-run` 不再尝试创建 action 子表
5. 手动检查 `TASK_FIELDS` 打印输出，确认字段完整且无重复

def action_pk_for_task(task_id: str) -> str:
    return f"A-{task_id}"


def action_shell_from_task(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """系统预建动作空壳：只填定位/责任信息，原因与采取动作留给负责人补全。

    写入策略必须为 create-only（已存在则不覆盖），避免冲掉人工填写。
    """
    task_id = str(task.get("task_id") or "")
    title_cn = task.get("product_title_cn") or ""
    title = task.get("product_title") or ""
    name = title_cn or title
    hint_parts = [
        "【系统预建】请负责人核实后补全：是否属实 / 原因 / 采取动作 / 复查日期",
        f"等级={task.get('level')}",
        f"类型={task.get('anomaly_type')}",
    ]
    if name:
        hint_parts.append(f"品名={name}")
    return {
        "主键": action_pk_for_task(task_id),
        "关联异常编号": task_id,
        "店铺": task.get("shop_name"),
        "ASIN": task.get("asin"),
        "中文名称": title_cn or None,
        "异常类型": task.get("anomaly_type"),
        "等级": task.get("level"),
        "是否属实": "待核实",
        "判断依据": "；".join(hint_parts),
        "执行日期": _biz_date_ts(str(task.get("biz_date") or ""))
        if task.get("biz_date")
        else None,
        "执行人": task.get("owner"),
        "闭环状态": "待核实",
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import time
from typing import Any, Callable

from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.store.db import Database
from app.sync.feishu_schema import (
    action_shell_from_task,
    row_to_asin_fields,
    task_to_fields,
)
from app.sync.shops import (
    ShopTableRegistry,
    dual_write_enabled,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# Columns that belong to system sync (never "human" fields in local schema)
SYSTEM_COLUMNS = {
    "biz_date",
    "marketplace",
    "shop_name",
    "shop_id",
    "asin",
    "parent_asin",
    "sku",
    "msku",
    "title",
    "title_cn",
    "brand",
    "open_date",
    "product_grade",
    "owner",
    "sale_price",
    "sale_num",
    "order_num",
    "avg_sale_price",
    "sale_price_change_pct",
    "order_num_change_pct",
    "sessions",
    "sessions_change_pct",
    "page_view",
    "conversion_rate",
    "conversion_rate_change_pp",
    "buy_box_percent",
    "ad_impression",
    "ad_clicks",
    "ad_ctr",
    "ad_cost",
    "ad_cost_change_pct",
    "cpc",
    "acos",
    "ad_sales",
    "available",
    "in_transit",
    "available_days",
    "inv_age_365_plus",
    "rating",
    "rating_change",
    "rating_count",
    "low_review_num",
    "review_num",
    "raw_json",
}


def write_rows(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    db: Database,
    sync_run_id: int,
    sink: str = "sqlite",
    settings: Settings | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Write mapped ASIN daily rows to configured sinks.

    sink: sqlite | feishu | both
    """
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    db_rows = []
    for r in rows:
        db_rows.append(
            {k: v for k, v in r.items() if k in SYSTEM_COLUMNS or k == "raw_json"}
        )

    n = 0
    if sink in ("sqlite", "both"):
        n = db.upsert_asin_rows(db_rows, sync_run_id)
        logger.info("SQLite upserted %s asin_daily rows", n)

    if sink in ("feishu", "both"):
        if not settings.has_feishu:
            logger.warning("sink 需要飞书但凭证未配置，已跳过飞书写入")
        elif not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token or not settings.feishu_table_asin_daily:
            logger.warning(
                "FEISHU_BITABLE_APP_TOKEN / FEISHU_TABLE_ASIN_DAILY 未配置，跳过"
            )
        else:
            n_feishu = write_asin_to_feishu(
                db_rows, settings=settings, sync_run_id=sync_run_id
            )
            logger.info("Feishu asin_daily upserted %s rows", n_feishu)
            n = max(n, n_feishu)

    return n


_LEGACY_TEXT_DATE_FIELDS = (
    "日期",
    "截止时间",
    "执行日期",
    "复查日期",
    "最近复盘日期",
)


def _ms_to_date_str(ms: float | int) -> str:
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    return datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000.0, tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def _fields_for_legacy_mother(fields: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """母表日期列常为文本 type=1，毫秒时间戳会触发 TextFieldConvFail。"""
    out = dict(fields)
    for key in _LEGACY_TEXT_DATE_FIELDS:
        d = out.get(key)
        if isinstance(d, (int, float)) and d > 10_000_000_000:
            out[key] = _ms_to_date_str(d)
    return out


def _upsert_payload(
    settings: Settings,
    table_id: str,
    payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    key_field: str = "主键",
) -> int:
    if not payload or not table_id:
        return 0
    from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient

    app_token = settings.feishu_bitable_app_token
    with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
        stats = client.upsert_by_text_key(
            app_token, table_id, payload, key_field=key_field
        )
    return int(stats.get("total") or 0)


def _create_if_absent_payload(
    settings: Settings,
    table_id: str,
    payload: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    key_field: str = "主键",
) -> dict[str, int]:
    if not payload or not table_id:
        return {"created": 0, "skipped": 0, "total": 0}
    from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient

    app_token = settings.feishu_bitable_app_token
    with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
        return client.create_records_if_absent(
            app_token, table_id, payload, key_field=key_field
        )


def dual_write_fields(
    settings: Settings,
    *,
    mother_table_id: str,
    kind: str,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    to_fields: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, Any] | None],
    shop_key: str = "shop_name",
    mode: str = "upsert",
    key_field: str = "主键",
) -> dict[str, int]:
    """母表全量写入 + 按规范店名写入子表。

    to_fields: 原始 row → 飞书 fields（可返回 None 跳过）
    mode: upsert | create_if_absent
    返回 {"mother": n, "children": n, "unknown_shop": n}
    """
    result = {"mother": 0, "children": 0, "unknown_shop": 0}
    if not settings.has_feishu or not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token:
        return result
    if not mother_table_id:
        return result

    # 构建 (row, fields) 对
    pairs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[str, Any]]] = []
    for r in rows:
        fields = to_fields(r)
        if not fields:
            continue
        fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if v is not None}
        if not fields.get(key_field):
            continue
        pairs.append((r, fields))
    if not pairs:
        return result

    # 母表历史字段「日期」多为文本；子表为 DATE(ms)。母表写入时转回 YYYY-MM-DD 字符串
    mother_payload = [_fields_for_legacy_mother(f) for _, f in pairs]
    if mode == "create_if_absent":
        st = _create_if_absent_payload(
            settings, mother_table_id, mother_payload, key_field=key_field
        )
        result["mother"] = int(st.get("total") or 0)
    else:
        result["mother"] = _upsert_payload(
            settings, mother_table_id, mother_payload, key_field=key_field
        )

    if not dual_write_enabled():
        return result

    registry = ShopTableRegistry.load(settings.shop_tables_path)
    if not registry.data:
        logger.debug("无 shop table registry，跳过子表双写")
        return result

    # 按规范店分组
    from app.sync.shops import canonicalize_shop, load_alias_map

    aliases = load_alias_map()
    shop_groups: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for r, fields in pairs:
        raw = r.get(shop_key) or r.get("店铺") or ""
        can = canonicalize_shop(str(raw) if raw else "", aliases)
        shop_groups.setdefault(can, []).append(fields)

    for can, payload in shop_groups.items():
        if not can:
            result["unknown_shop"] += len(payload)
            logger.warning("无法规范店名的记录 %d 条，仅已写母表", len(payload))
            continue
        child_id = registry.get(can, kind)
        if not child_id:
            result["unknown_shop"] += len(payload)
            logger.warning("店铺 [%s] 无 %s 子表，仅已写母表", can, kind)
            continue
        if mode == "create_if_absent":
            st = _create_if_absent_payload(
                settings, child_id, payload, key_field=key_field
            )
            result["children"] += int(st.get("total") or 0)
        else:
            result["children"] += _upsert_payload(
                settings, child_id, payload, key_field=key_field
            )
        time.sleep(0.15)

    logger.info(
        "dual_write kind=%s mother=%s children=%s unknown=%s",
        kind,
        result["mother"],
        result["children"],
        result["unknown_shop"],
    )
    return result


def write_asin_to_feishu(
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    sync_run_id: int | None = None,
) -> int:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    table_id = settings.feishu_table_asin_daily
    if not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token or not table_id:
        return 0

    def to_fields(r: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        if not r.get("asin"):
            return None
        return row_to_asin_fields(r, sync_run_id=sync_run_id)

    stats = dual_write_fields(
        settings,
        mother_table_id=table_id,
        kind="asin_daily",
        rows=rows,
        to_fields=to_fields,
        shop_key="shop_name",
        mode="upsert",
    )
    return int(stats.get("mother") or 0)


def write_tasks_to_feishu(
    tasks: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
) -> int:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    table_id = settings.feishu_table_tasks
    if not settings.has_feishu or not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token or not table_id:
        logger.warning("飞书任务表未配置，跳过任务同步")
        return 0

    def to_fields(t: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
        fields = task_to_fields(t)
        fields = {k: v for k, v in fields.items() if v is not None}
        if not fields.get("主键"):
            return None
        return fields

    stats = dual_write_fields(
        settings,
        mother_table_id=table_id,
        kind="tasks",
        rows=tasks,
        to_fields=to_fields,
        shop_key="shop_name",
        mode="upsert",
    )
    return int(stats.get("mother") or 0)

def dispatch_open_tasks(
    db: Database,
    biz_date: str,
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    push_tasks: bool = True,
    notify_owners: bool = True,
    escalate: bool = False,
    dry_run_notify: bool = False,
    only_new_notify: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """日批后半段：推飞书任务 → 按负责人通知 → 逾期升级。"""

        t
        for t in db.list_tasks(biz_date=biz_date)
        if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")
        and t.get("level") in ("red", "orange")
    ]
    out: dict[str, Any] = {
        "open_tasks": len(open_tasks),
        "feishu_tasks": 0,
        "owner_push": {},
    }

    if push_tasks and open_tasks:
        try:
            out["feishu_tasks"] = write_tasks_to_feishu(open_tasks, settings=settings)
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("推飞书任务失败")
            out["feishu_tasks_error"] = str(e)

    if notify_owners:
        try:
            out["owner_push"] = push_tasks_to_owners(
                db,
                biz_date,
                settings=settings,
                dry_run=dry_run_notify,
                only_new=only_new_notify,
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("负责人推送失败")
            out["owner_push_error"] = str(e)

    if escalate:
        from app.notify.escalate import send_escalate_notification

        try:
            out["escalate"] = send_escalate_notification(
                db, settings=settings, dry_run=dry_run_notify
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("逾期升级通知失败")
            out["escalate_error"] = str(e)

    return out

def _build_owner_card(
    owner: str,
    items: list[dict[str, Any]],
    biz_date: str,
    tasks_url: str,
    actions_url: str,
    open_id: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """为单个负责人构建交互式卡片。"""

        card_action,
        card_button,
        card_header,
        card_hr,
        card_md,
    )

    red = [t for t in items if t.get("level") == "red"]
    orange = [t for t in items if t.get("level") == "orange"]
    ordered = sorted(
        items,
        key=lambda x: (0 if x.get("level") == "red" else 1, x.get("shop_name") or ""),
    )

    # 卡片颜色
    card_color = "red" if red else "orange"

    # @ 提及
    at_line = ""
    if open_id:
        at_line = f"<at id={open_id}></at>\n"

    md_lines = [
        f"{at_line}📅 **{biz_date}** 待你处理",
        "",
        f"👤 **{owner}** | 🔴 {len(red)} | 🟠 {len(orange)}",
        "",
        "> 请打开「运营动作记录」补全：是否属实 / 原因 / 采取动作 / 复查日期",
        "",
    ]
    for t in ordered[:8]:
        icon = "🔴" if t.get("level") == "red" else "🟠"
        cn = t.get("product_title_cn") or t.get("product_title") or ""
        cn_s = f" {cn}" if cn else ""
        # 指标语义：优先 value_summary / message，避免只显示裸数字
        metric = ""
        payload = t.get("payload_json")
        if isinstance(payload, str) and payload:
            try:
                payload = _json.loads(payload)
            except Exception:
                payload = {}
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            payload = {}
        summary = t.get("value_summary") or payload.get("value_summary")
        message = t.get("message") or payload.get("message")
        if summary:
            metric = f" · {summary}"
        elif message:
            metric = f" · {message}"
        md_lines.append(
            f"{icon} `{t.get('task_id')}` {t.get('shop_name')} {t.get('asin')}{cn_s}"
            f" | {t.get('anomaly_type')}{metric}"
        )
    if len(ordered) > 8:
        md_lines.append(f"…另有 {len(ordered) - 8} 条，见任务表")

    elements = [
        card_md("\n".join(md_lines)),
        card_hr(),
        card_action(
            card_button("📝 打开动作表", actions_url, primary=True),
            card_button("📋 查看任务表", tasks_url),
        ),
    ]

    title = f"{'🔴' if red else '🟠'} 待你处理 · {biz_date}"
    return {
        **card_header(title, color=card_color),
        "elements": elements,
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import json as _json
import logging
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any

from app.config import Settings, get_app_config, get_settings
from app.store.db import Database

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def build_digest(db: Database, biz_date: str) -> str:
    """构建纯文本摘要（保留为 fallback）。"""
    tasks = db.list_tasks(biz_date=biz_date)
    open_tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")]
    by_owner: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for t in open_tasks:
        by_owner[str(t.get("owner") or "未分配")].append(t)

    red = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "red")
    orange = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "orange")
    lines = [
        f"【ASIN健康度】{biz_date} 异常摘要",
        f"红色: {red} | 橙色: {orange} | 未关闭合计: {len(open_tasks)}",
        "",
    ]
    cfg = get_app_config()
    view_url = (cfg.get("notify") or {}).get("view_base_url") or ""
    if view_url:
        lines.append(f"视图: {view_url}")
        lines.append("")

    for owner, items in sorted(by_owner.items()):
        r = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "red")
        o = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "orange")
        lines.append(f"- {owner}: 红{r} 橙{o}")
        for t in items[:5]:
            lines.append(
                f"  · [{t.get('level')}] {t.get('shop_name')} {t.get('asin')} {t.get('anomaly_type')}"
            )
        if len(items) > 5:
            lines.append(f"  · …另有 {len(items) - 5} 条")

    if not open_tasks:
        lines.append("今日无新增未关闭橙/红任务。")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def build_digest_card(
    db: Database, biz_date: str, *, settings: Settings | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """构建每日摘要交互式卡片。"""
    from app.clients.feishu import (
        card_action,
        card_button,
        card_header,
        card_hr,
        card_md,
    )

    settings = settings or get_settings()
    cfg = get_app_config()
    notify = cfg.get("notify") or {}
    base_url = (notify.get("view_base_url") or "").rstrip("?&")
    if not base_url and settings.feishu_bitable_app_token:
        base_url = f"https://dcnkj1up67d5.feishu.cn/base/{settings.feishu_bitable_app_token}"

    tasks_url = base_url
    actions_url = base_url
    if settings.feishu_table_tasks:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base_url else "?"
        tasks_url = f"{base_url}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_tasks}"
    if settings.feishu_table_actions:
        sep = "&" if "?" in base_url else "?"
        actions_url = f"{base_url}{sep}table={settings.feishu_table_actions}"

    tasks = db.list_tasks(biz_date=biz_date)
    open_tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.get("status") not in ("closed", "resolved")]
    yellow_tasks = [t for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "yellow"]
    by_owner: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for t in open_tasks:
        by_owner[str(t.get("owner") or "未分配")].append(t)

    red = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "red")
    orange = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if t.get("level") == "orange")
    yellow = len(yellow_tasks)

    # 卡片颜色：有红色→红，有橙色→橙，否则蓝
    card_color = "blue"
    if red:
        card_color = "red"
    elif orange:
        card_color = "orange"

    # 逾期统计
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    overdue_n = sum(1 for t in open_tasks if (due := t.get("due_at")) and due < now)

    # KPI 行
    kpi_parts = [
        f"🔴 **红色**: {red}",
        f"🟠 **橙色**: {orange}",
        f"🟡 **观察**: {yellow}",
    ]
    if overdue_n:
        kpi_parts.append(f"⏰ **逾期**: {overdue_n}")

    md_lines = [f"📊 **{biz_date}** 异常摘要", "", " | ".join(kpi_parts), ""]

    if not open_tasks:
        md_lines.append("✅ 今日无新增未关闭橙/红任务。")
    else:
        md_lines.append("---")
        md_lines.append("")
        for owner, items in sorted(by_owner.items()):
            r = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "red")
            o = sum(1 for t in items if t.get("level") == "orange")
            md_lines.append(f"👤 **{owner}**: 🔴{r} 🟠{o}")
            for t in items[:5]:
                icon = "🔴" if t.get("level") == "red" else "🟠"
                cn = t.get("product_title_cn") or t.get("product_title") or ""
                cn_s = f" {cn}" if cn else ""
                md_lines.append(
                    f"  {icon} `{t.get('task_id')}` {t.get('shop_name')} "
                    f"{t.get('asin')}{cn_s} | {t.get('anomaly_type')}"
                )
            if len(items) > 5:
                md_lines.append(f"  …另有 {len(items) - 5} 条")
            md_lines.append("")

    elements = [
        card_md("\n".join(md_lines)),
        card_hr(),
        card_action(
            card_button("📋 查看任务表", tasks_url),
            card_button("📝 查看动作表", actions_url),
        ),
    ]

    return {
        **card_header(
            f"ASIN健康度 · {biz_date} 异常摘要", color=card_color
        ),
        "elements": elements,
    }


def _send_msg(
    text: str | None,
    card: dict[str, Any] | None,
    webhook: str,
    *,
    use_card: bool = True,
) -> bool:
    """发送消息：优先卡片，fallback 文本。返回是否发送成功。"""
    if use_card and card:
        try:
            from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient

            if get_settings().has_feishu:
                with FeishuClient() as client:
                    client.send_webhook_card(card, webhook=webhook)
            else:
                import httpx
                resp = httpx.post(webhook, json={"msg_type": "interactive", "card": card}, timeout=30)
                resp.raise_for_status()
            return True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("卡片发送失败，回退文本")

    if text:
        try:
            import httpx
            resp = httpx.post(
                webhook,
                json={"msg_type": "text", "content": {"text": text}},
                timeout=30,
            )
            resp.raise_for_status()
            data = resp.json() if resp.content else {}
            if data.get("code") not in (None, 0) and data.get("StatusCode") not in (None, 0):
                logger.error("飞书 webhook 返回异常: %s", data)
            return True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("文本消息发送也失败")
    return False


def send_digest(
    db: Database,
    biz_date: str,
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> str:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    text = build_digest(db, biz_date)
    card = build_digest_card(db, biz_date, settings=settings)

    payload = {"biz_date": biz_date, "text": text, "card": card}
    db.log_notify("daily_digest", payload)

    if dry_run:
        logger.info("Digest dry-run:\n%s\nCard:\n%s", text, _json.dumps(card, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return text

    webhook = (settings.feishu_bot_webhook or "").strip()
    if not webhook:
        logger.warning(
            "未配置 FEISHU_BOT_WEBHOOK，摘要仅写入 notify_log。"
            "请在飞书群添加自定义机器人，把 Webhook 写入 .env"
        )
        return text

    _send_msg(text, card, webhook)
    logger.info("飞书摘要已发送")
    return text

                import httpx
                resp = httpx.post(webhook, json={"msg_type": "interactive", "card": card}, timeout=30)
                resp.raise_for_status()
            return True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("卡片发送失败，回退文本")

    if text:
        try:
            import httpx
            resp = httpx.post(
                webhook,
                json={"msg_type": "text", "content": {"text": text}},
                timeout=30,
            )
            resp.raise_for_status()
            data = resp.json() if resp.content else {}
            if data.get("code") not in (None, 0) and data.get("StatusCode") not in (None, 0):
                logger.error("飞书 webhook 返回异常: %s", data)
            return True
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("文本消息发送也失败")
    return False


def send_digest(
    db: Database,
    biz_date: str,
    *,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> str:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    text = build_digest(db, biz_date)
    card = build_digest_card(db, biz_date, settings=settings)

    payload = {"biz_date": biz_date, "text": text, "card": card}
    db.log_notify("daily_digest", payload)

    if dry_run:
        logger.info("Digest dry-run:\n%s\nCard:\n%s", text, _json.dumps(card, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return text

    webhook = (settings.feishu_bot_webhook or "").strip()
    if not webhook:
        logger.warning(
            "未配置 FEISHU_BOT_WEBHOOK，摘要仅写入 notify_log。"
            "请在飞书群添加自定义机器人，把 Webhook 写入 .env"
        )
        return text

    _send_msg(text, card, webhook)
    logger.info("飞书摘要已发送")
    return text

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""按逻辑店铺创建飞书业务子表（母表保留，命名：母表名__规范店名）。

用法:
  python scripts/init_shop_tables.py --dry-run
  python scripts/init_shop_tables.py
  python scripts/init_shop_tables.py --shops Ledvia-UK,Nottac-UK
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import copy
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient, FeishuError
from app.config import get_settings
from app.sync.feishu_schema import TABLE_SPECS
from app.sync.shops import (
    KIND_TO_MOTHER_NAME,
    ShopTableRegistry,
    TABLE_KINDS,
    child_table_name,
    default_registry_path,
    list_canonical_shops_from_db,
    list_canonical_shops_from_names,
)

# TABLE_SPECS env_key → kind
ENV_TO_KIND = {
    "FEISHU_TABLE_ASIN_DAILY": "asin_daily",
    "FEISHU_TABLE_TASKS": "tasks",
    "FEISHU_TABLE_CONFIG": "config",
    "FEISHU_TABLE_DAILY_SUMMARY": "daily_summary",
    "FEISHU_TABLE_PRODUCT_MASTER": "product_master",
}


def _fields_for_create(mother_name: str, fields: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """创建时去掉单向关联(type=18)：需指向动作子表，稍后单独补。"""
    out = []
    for f in fields:
        f = copy.deepcopy(f)
        if f.get("type") == 18:
            continue  # 关联运营动作 等
        # create_table 不接受非法 property
        out.append(f)
    return out


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="初始化按店飞书子表")
    parser.add_argument("--shops", default="", help="逗号分隔规范店名；默认从本地库")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--registry",
        default="",
        help="输出 JSON 路径，默认 data/feishu_shop_tables.json",
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.has_feishu or not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token:
        print("ERROR: 需要 FEISHU_APP_ID/SECRET 与 FEISHU_BITABLE_APP_TOKEN")
        return 2

    if args.shops.strip():
        shops = list_canonical_shops_from_names(
            [s.strip() for s in args.shops.split(",") if s.strip()]
        )
    else:
        shops = list_canonical_shops_from_db()

    if not shops:
        print("ERROR: 无规范店铺列表")
        return 2

    registry_path = Path(args.registry) if args.registry else default_registry_path()
    print(f"逻辑店铺({len(shops)}): {shops}")
    print(f"registry → {registry_path}")
    print(f"kinds: {list(TABLE_KINDS)}")

    planned = []
    for shop in shops:
        for kind, mother in KIND_TO_MOTHER_NAME.items():
            planned.append((shop, kind, child_table_name(mother, shop)))
    print(f"将确保 {len(planned)} 张子表")
    if args.dry_run:
        for shop, kind, name in planned:
            print(f"  {name}  ({kind})")
        print("[DRY-RUN] 未调用飞书")
        return 0

    # mother_name → fields
    name_to_fields = {s["name"]: s["fields"] for s in TABLE_SPECS}
    name_to_kind = {}
    for s in TABLE_SPECS:
        kind = ENV_TO_KIND.get(s["env_key"])
        if kind:
            name_to_kind[s["name"]] = kind

    registry = ShopTableRegistry.load(registry_path)
    app = settings.feishu_bitable_app_token

    try:
        with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
            existing = {
                t.get("name"): t.get("table_id")
                for t in client.list_tables(app)
                if t.get("name") and t.get("table_id")
            }
            print(f"base 已有表 {len(existing)} 张")

            # 先建非 tasks 关联依赖：全部表先建（tasks 去掉 link 字段）
            for shop in shops:
                for mother_name, kind in [
                    (KIND_TO_MOTHER_NAME[k], k) for k in TABLE_KINDS
                ]:
                    tname = child_table_name(mother_name, shop)
                    if tname in existing and existing[tname]:
                        tid = existing[tname]
                        print(f"exists: {tname} -> {tid}")
                        registry.set(shop, kind, tid)
                        continue
                    fields = name_to_fields.get(mother_name) or []
                    create_fields = _fields_for_create(mother_name, fields)
                    print(f"create: {tname} ({len(create_fields)} fields) ...")
                    try:
                        data = client.create_table(app, tname, create_fields)
                        tid = (
                            data.get("table_id")
                            or (data.get("table") or {}).get("table_id")
                            or ""
                        )
                        if not tid:
                            print(f"  FAIL no table_id: {data}")
                            continue
                        print(f"  OK {tid}")
                        existing[tname] = tid
                        registry.set(shop, kind, tid)
                        time.sleep(0.35)
                    except FeishuError as e:
                        print(f"  FAIL [{e.code}] {e.message}")

        path = registry.save(registry_path)
        print(f"\n✅ 已写入注册表: {path}")
        print(json_summary(registry))
        return 0
    except FeishuError as e:
        print(f"FEISHU ERROR [{e.code}] {e.message}")
        return 1


def json_summary(registry: ShopTableRegistry) -> str:
    lines = ["shops:"]
    for shop in registry.shops():
        kinds = registry.data.get(shop) or {}
        lines.append(f"  {shop}: {len(kinds)} kinds")
    return "\n".join(lines)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python
"""在异常任务表末尾追加运营动作信息列，并建立与运营动作记录表的关联。

实现步骤：
  1. 在「异常任务」表创建单向关联字段（type=18）→ 「运营动作记录」表
  2. 创建文本列：「动作-闭环状态」「动作-原因」「动作-采取动作」「动作-是否有效」「动作-复查日期」
  3. 回填已有记录的关联关系和数据（按"关联异常编号"="异常编号"匹配）
  4. 日报运行时自动维护这些列的数据

用法:
  python scripts/setup_action_lookup.py            # 完整执行
  python scripts/setup_action_lookup.py --dry-run  # 仅检测，不创建/写入
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import logging
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from app.clients.feishu import FeishuClient
from app.config import get_settings

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s: %(message)s",
)
logger = logging.getLogger("setup_action_lookup")

# ── 配置 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
LINK_FIELD_NAME = "关联运营动作"      # 单向关联字段（type=18）

# 从运营动作记录表复制到异常任务表的字段: { 任务表列名: 动作表列名 }
ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS: dict[str, str] = {
    "动作-闭环状态": "闭环状态",
    "动作-原因": "原因",
    "动作-采取动作": "采取动作",
    "动作-是否有效": "是否有效",
    "动作-复查日期": "复查日期",
}


def setup(
    client: FeishuClient,
    app_token: str,
    task_table_id: str,
    action_table_id: str,
    *,
    dry_run: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {
        "link_field_created": False,
        "text_columns_created": [],
        "links_backfilled": 0,
        "action_data_backfilled": 0,
    }

    # ── 1. 获取现有字段 ──────────────────────────────────────────
    logger.info("=== 获取异常任务表字段 ===")
    task_fields = client.list_fields(app_token, task_table_id)
    task_field_names = {f.get("field_name") for f in task_fields}

    logger.info("=== 获取运营动作记录表字段 ===")
    action_fields = client.list_fields(app_token, action_table_id)
    action_field_names = {f.get("field_name") for f in action_fields}

    if "异常编号" not in task_field_names:
        logger.error("异常任务表缺少「异常编号」字段！")
        return result
    if "关联异常编号" not in action_field_names:
        logger.error("运营动作记录表缺少「关联异常编号」字段！")
        return result

    # ── 2. 创建单向关联字段（type=18） ──────────────────────────
    if LINK_FIELD_NAME in task_field_names:
        for f in task_fields:
            if f["field_name"] == LINK_FIELD_NAME:
                logger.info("关联字段 [%s] 已存在 (id=%s type=%s)", LINK_FIELD_NAME, f.get("field_id"), f.get("type"))
                break
        result["link_field_created"] = False
    else:
        if dry_run:
            logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将创建单向关联字段 [%s]", LINK_FIELD_NAME)
            result["link_field_created"] = True
        else:
            resp = client.create_field(
                app_token, task_table_id, LINK_FIELD_NAME, 18,
                property_={"table_id": action_table_id},
            )
            fid = resp.get("field", {}).get("field_id") or resp.get("field_id")
            logger.info("✅ 创建单向关联字段 [%s] (id=%s)", LINK_FIELD_NAME, fid)
            result["link_field_created"] = True
            task_field_names.add(LINK_FIELD_NAME)
            time.sleep(0.3)

    # ── 3. 创建动作信息文本列 ───────────────────────────────────
    for col_name in ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS:
        if col_name in task_field_names:
            logger.info("字段 [%s] 已存在，跳过", col_name)
        else:
            if dry_run:
                logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将创建文本字段 [%s]", col_name)
                result["text_columns_created"].append(col_name)
            else:
                client.create_field(app_token, task_table_id, col_name, 1)
                logger.info("✅ 创建文本字段 [%s]", col_name)
                result["text_columns_created"].append(col_name)
                task_field_names.add(col_name)
                time.sleep(0.15)

    # ── 4. 回填关联关系 ─────────────────────────────────────────
    logger.info("=== 回填关联关系 ===")

    # 读取运营动作表
    action_info: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for item in client.iter_records(app_token, action_table_id, page_size=100):
        rid = item.get("record_id")
        fields = item.get("fields") or {}
        key = str(fields.get("关联异常编号") or "").strip()
        if key:
            action_info[key] = {"record_id": rid, "fields": fields}
    logger.info("运营动作记录: %d 条", len(action_info))

    # 读取异常任务表，找出需要回填的记录
    to_link: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    to_update_action: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for item in client.iter_records(app_token, task_table_id, page_size=100):
        rid = item.get("record_id")
        fields = item.get("fields") or {}
        task_no = str(fields.get("异常编号") or "").strip()
        if not task_no or not rid:
            continue
        action = action_info.get(task_no)
        if not action:
            continue

        # 检查是否需要回填关联
        link_val = fields.get(LINK_FIELD_NAME)
        has_real_link = False
        if link_val and isinstance(link_val, list):
            for lv in link_val:
                if isinstance(lv, dict) and lv.get("record_ids"):
                    has_real_link = True
                    break
        if not has_real_link:
            to_link.append({
                "record_id": rid,
                "fields": {LINK_FIELD_NAME: [action["record_id"]]},
            })

        # 检查是否需要回填动作文本列
        action_updates = {}
        for task_col, action_col in ACTION_COPY_COLUMNS.items():
            action_val = action["fields"].get(action_col)
            if action_val is not None and str(action_val).strip():
                existing = fields.get(task_col)
                if not existing or str(existing).strip() != str(action_val).strip():
                    action_updates[task_col] = action_val
        if action_updates:
            to_update_action.append({"record_id": rid, "fields": action_updates})

    result["links_backfilled"] = len(to_link)
    result["action_data_backfilled"] = len(to_update_action)

    if to_link:
        if dry_run:
            logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将回填 %d 条关联", len(to_link))
        else:
            for i in range(0, len(to_link), 100):
                chunk = to_link[i : i + 100]
                client.bitable_batch_update(app_token, task_table_id, chunk)
                logger.info("  关联回填 %d/%d", min(i + 100, len(to_link)), len(to_link))
                time.sleep(0.2)
            logger.info("✅ 关联回填完成: %d 条", len(to_link))
    else:
        logger.info("无需回填（所有关联已就绪）")

    if to_update_action:
        if dry_run:
            logger.info("[DRY-RUN] 将更新 %d 条动作数据", len(to_update_action))
        else:
            for i in range(0, len(to_update_action), 100):
                chunk = to_update_action[i : i + 100]
                client.bitable_batch_update(app_token, task_table_id, chunk)
                logger.info("  动作数据 %d/%d", min(i + 100, len(to_update_action)), len(to_update_action))
                time.sleep(0.2)
            logger.info("✅ 动作数据回填完成: %d 条", len(to_update_action))
    else:
        logger.info("无需回填动作数据")

    return result


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="异常任务表添加运营动作信息列")
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="只检测不写入")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.has_feishu:
        logger.error("缺少飞书凭证")
        sys.exit(1)

    app_token = settings.feishu_bitable_app_token
    task_table_id = settings.feishu_table_tasks
    action_table_id = settings.feishu_table_actions

    if not app_token or not task_table_id or not action_table_id:
        logger.error("缺少 Bitable 表配置")
        sys.exit(1)

    logger.info("Bitable: %s", app_token)
    logger.info("异常任务表: %s", task_table_id)
    logger.info("运营动作记录表: %s", action_table_id)
    logger.info("模式: %s", "DRY-RUN" if args.dry_run else "执行")

    with FeishuClient(settings) as client:
        result = setup(client, app_token, task_table_id, action_table_id, dry_run=args.dry_run)

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("执行结果:")
    print(f"  单向关联字段: {'✅ 已创建' if result['link_field_created'] else '⏭️ 已存在'}")
    print(f"  文本列创建: {result['text_columns_created']}")
    print(f"  关联回填: {result['links_backfilled']} 条")
    print(f"  动作数据回填: {result['action_data_backfilled']} 条")

    if args.dry_run:
        print("\n⚠️  DRY-RUN 模式，未实际修改。去掉 --dry-run 执行。")
    else:
        print("\n✅ 完成！异常任务表末尾现在有：关联运营动作 | 动作-闭环状态 | 动作-原因 | 动作-采取动作 | 动作-是否有效 | 动作-复查日期")

    print("\n📌 日常维护:")
    print("  日报 dispatch 流程会自动更新这些列的数据。")
    print("=" * 60)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# 飞书接入指南（ASIN 健康度一期）

## 你需要准备什么

最少两样（**发给开发时注意脱敏，不要发到公开群**）：

| 配置项 | 从哪拿 | 示例形态 |
|---|---|---|
| `FEISHU_APP_ID` | 飞书开放平台 → 你的企业自建应用 → 凭证与基础信息 | `cli_xxx` |
| `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | 同上 | 一串密钥 |

有了上面两个，可运行脚本**自动创建**多维表格，并生成：

| 配置项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `FEISHU_BITABLE_APP_TOKEN` | 多维表格 app_token |
| `FEISHU_TABLE_ASIN_DAILY` | ASIN每日数据 table_id |
| `FEISHU_TABLE_TASKS` | 异常任务 table_id |
| `FEISHU_TABLE_ACTIONS` | 运营动作 table_id |
| `FEISHU_TABLE_CONFIG` | 配置表 table_id |

可选：

| 配置项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `FEISHU_BOT_WEBHOOK` | 群自定义机器人 Webhook，用于日报摘要 |

---

## 创建应用（管理员 / IT 约 10 分钟）

1. 打开 [飞书开放平台](https://open.feishu.cn/app)
2. **创建企业自建应用**，名称如：`ASIN健康度同步`
3. **权限管理** 搜索并开通（**应用身份权限**，不是用户身份）：
   - **必选**：`bitable:app`（查看、评论、编辑和管理多维表格）  
     或至少 `base:app:create`（创建多维表格）
   - **建议**：`bitable:app:readonly`
   - 若要从云空间列文件再加：`drive:drive` 或 `drive:file`
   - 开通后点权限页里的申请链接，例如：  
     `https://open.feishu.cn/app/cli_xxx/auth?q=bitable:app,base:app:create`
4. **版本管理与发布** → 创建版本（勾选新增权限）→ **申请线上发布**  
   （未发布则 OpenAPI 仍会报 99991672 无权限）
5. 复制 **App ID**、**App Secret**

### 若你已有多维表格（不用脚本建）

1. 浏览器打开该多维表格  
2. 从 URL 取 `app_token`：  
   `https://xxx.feishu.cn/base/**APP_TOKEN**?...`  
3. 各子表：表头菜单 / 开发者工具 / API 调试里看 `table_id`（或以脚本 `--app-token` 列表现有表）  
4. 把应用添加为该多维表格的**协作者（可编辑）**

---

## 配置步骤

### 1. 写入 `.env`

```env
FEISHU_APP_ID=cli_xxxx
FEISHU_APP_SECRET=xxxx
```

### 2. 初始化四张表

```powershell
cd "E:\project\亚马逊平台驾驶舱-店铺数据"
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python scripts\init_feishu_tables.py
```

成功后把打印的 / `data/feishu_env.snippet.txt` 内容合并进 `.env`。

### 3. 冒烟

```powershell
python scripts\smoke_feishu.py
```

### 4. 打开双写

编辑 `config/config.yaml`：

```yaml
sync:
  sink: both   # sqlite | feishu | both
```

### 5. 同步数据 + 任务

```powershell
python -m app.main sync --date 2026-07-21
python -m app.main rules --date 2026-07-21 --reset-tasks
python -m app.main push-feishu-tasks --date 2026-07-21
```

---

## 四张表用途

| 表名 | 谁写 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| ASIN每日数据 | 系统 | 赛狐同步底表；含「主键」防重复；**产品名称**后为 **中文名称**（赛狐本地品名） |
| 异常任务 | 系统 | 橙/红任务；**产品**后为 **中文名称** |
| 运营动作记录 | 人 | 原因、动作、复查（系统不覆盖） |
| 配置表 | 人/管理员 | 负责人、阈值（二期可读飞书覆盖 YAML） |

已有多维表补「中文名称」列并回填历史：

```powershell
python scripts\add_title_cn_fields.py --backfill
```

---

## 数据模型：母表 + 按店子表（方案 B）

**母表仍保留全量**，便于跨店总览；同时为每个逻辑店铺建立一套业务**子表**（仅本店数据），便于单独授权与打开。

| 做法 | 是否采用 |
|---|---|
| 母表全量双写 + 子表按店 | ✅ 当前方案 |
| 命名：`{母表名}__{规范店名}`，如 `ASIN每日数据__Nottac-UK` | ✅ |
| 店铺别名归一（`LEDVIE`/`Ledvia` → `Ledvia-UK`） | ✅ `config.shop_aliases` |
| 母表上「店铺_*」筛选视图 | ✅ 可选备用，见下 |

### 初始化子表（约 6 店 × 6 逻辑表）

```powershell
python scripts\init_shop_tables.py --dry-run
python scripts\init_shop_tables.py
# 注册表：data/feishu_shop_tables.json
```

`config/config.yaml`：

```yaml
sync:
  sink: both
  dual_write_shop_tables: true   # 关闭则只写母表
```

### 补历史到子表

```powershell
python -m app.main backfill-shop-tables --date 2026-07-21
```

### 母表按店视图（可选）

```powershell
python scripts\setup_asin_shop_views.py --cleanup
python scripts\setup_feishu_views.py
```

---

## 老板视图（脚本 + 飞书 UI）

在「异常任务」**母表**：

1. **今日红色**：等级 = red  
2. **逾期**：截止时间 < 今天 且 状态 ≠ closed  
3. **待老板决策**：需要老板决策 = 勾选  

单店协作：直接打开子表 `异常任务__特米-UK` / `运营动作记录__特米-UK`（可只把该子表加为协作者）。

| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 99991663 / 无权限 | 开通 bitable 权限并发布应用 |
| 找不到 app | 应用未发布或企业禁用 |
| 写入 1254043 字段不存在 | 列名与 `feishu_schema` 不一致，用 init 脚本建表 |
| 重复行 | 确认有「主键」字段且用 upsert |

from __future__ import annotations

from app.notify.owner_push import build_owner_messages
from app.sync.feishu_schema import action_pk_for_task, action_shell_from_task


def test_action_shell_is_pending_for_owner():
    task = {
        "task_id": "T20260721-abc",
        "biz_date": "2026-07-21",
        "shop_name": "特米-UK",
        "asin": "B0TEST",
        "product_title": "English Title",
        "product_title_cn": "G4 20W",
        "anomaly_type": "sales_drop",
        "level": "red",
        "owner": "潘启豪",
        "status": "open",
    }
    shell = action_shell_from_task(task)
    assert shell["主键"] == action_pk_for_task("T20260721-abc")
    assert shell["关联异常编号"] == "T20260721-abc"
    assert shell["店铺"] == "特米-UK"
    assert shell["ASIN"] == "B0TEST"
    assert shell["中文名称"] == "G4 20W"
    assert shell["执行人"] == "潘启豪"
    assert shell["闭环状态"] == "待核实"
    assert shell["是否属实"] == "待核实"
    # 负责人补全字段不由系统写死成有效结论
    assert "原因" not in shell or not shell.get("原因")
    assert "采取动作" not in shell or not shell.get("采取动作")


def test_build_owner_messages_groups_by_owner():
    tasks = [
        {
            "task_id": "T1",
            "shop_name": "特米-UK",
            "asin": "A1",
            "level": "red",
            "anomaly_type": "sales_drop",
            "owner": "潘启豪",
            "status": "open",
            "product_title_cn": "灯珠",
            "value_summary": "当日销售额 7000 · 销售额环比 -30%",
        },
        {
            "task_id": "T2",
            "shop_name": "字同道合",
            "asin": "A2",
            "level": "orange",
            "anomaly_type": "inventory_low",
            "owner": "梦晴",
            "status": "open",
        },
        {
            "task_id": "T3",
            "shop_name": "x",
            "asin": "A3",
            "level": "yellow",
            "anomaly_type": "sales_drop",
            "owner": "梦晴",
            "status": "open",
        },
    ]
    msgs = build_owner_messages(tasks, biz_date="2026-07-21")
    owners = {m["owner"] for m in msgs}
    assert owners == {"潘启豪", "梦晴"}
    pan = next(m for m in msgs if m["owner"] == "潘启豪")
    assert pan["red"] == 1 and pan["orange"] == 0
    assert "T1" in pan["text"]
    assert "待你处理" in pan["text"]
    assert "当日销售额" in pan["text"]
